description:
Get the public proof for one graded book: signed payload, hash, signature, content address and timestamp
    material, with the steps to check them. The verified field is the server's own check; the evidence lets you repeat
    it yourself. Use this to check a book's signature and timestamp, and get_resolved_batch to read its forecasts and
    outcomes. An ungraded or unknown date is an error.

trading_date.description: The book's trading date, as YYYY-MM-DD. list_resolved_batches gives the graded dates.
trading_date.title: Trading Date

title: Verification record
